facts.value: QTEM (Quantitative Techniques for Economics and Management) is a growing international network of leading universities worldwide, supported by international corporate partners, with Banco Santander as a partner.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The QTEM programme includes one or two semesters abroad and an internship.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: QTEM Track 1: 1 semester abroad + an internship of 240 hours
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: QTEM Track 2: 2 semesters abroad + an internship of 240 hours
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: All QTEM students participate in the QTEM Global Business Analytics Challenge (GBAC, 8 ECTS), which involves group work on a business case and two preparatory courses focused on soft skills necessary for team collaboration and case resolution.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: 50 ECTS points in quantitative courses are required, including 22 ECTS per semester abroad at a QTEM partner university.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The Master's thesis is written at the home university in Frankfurt.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Upon successful completion of the QTEM programme and the Master's studies of the department, students receive the Master's degree from the department as well as a QTEM certificate.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: A valid GMAT score of at least 555 points is required or an equivalent GRE score (e.g., 155 in Verbal Reasoning and 159 in Quantitative Reasoning).
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: As of the fourth quarter of 2024, a new GMAT test format will be introduced, but the old format is still accepted with a minimum score of 600.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The QTEM exchange takes place in the 3rd and/or 4th semester.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Students in their first semester of the Master's programmes in Business Administration (BWL), Management Science (Mgmt Sc.), Money, Macro and Finance (MMF), and International Economics and Economic Policy (MIEEP) are eligible to apply.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The application deadline for the academic year 2026/27 is February 1, 2026.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: New announcements will be published at the end of October, with the application deadline for the following year being February 1.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
